_comment: TestFlight 외부 테스트 안내 문구 (.github/scripts/asc_testflight.py external 이 읽는다). 이메일은 ASC 의 Beta App Review 연락처를 그대로 쓴다.
description:
Kitty Queens is a calm logic puzzle. Place one cat in every color region so that each row and each column has exactly one cat, and no two cats touch — not even at the corners. Every board has exactly one solution, so you can always get there by reasoning, never by guessing.

Modes: Today's Puzzle (one new 7×7 board per day, the same for everyone) and 500 Levels from 5×5 up to 9×9. Works offline. No account, no sign-in.
whatsNew:
Thanks for helping test Kitty Queens! Please spend 5–10 minutes:
1) Play Today's Puzzle from the home screen.
2) Play a few Levels (Home > All levels). Levels 1–30 are free.
3) If you get stuck, try the Hint button; if you lose all hearts, try 'Watch video'. Test ads may not always load — you still get the reward.

Then tell us three things (TestFlight > Send Beta Feedback, or reply to the invite):
• One thing you liked
• One thing that was confusing or annoying
• How likely you'd recommend it to a friend (0–10)

Known: the ads are test ads in this build. Nothing is collected about you.
